description: Searches and traces academic literature via DAAF's provenance CLI `bash /daaf/scripts/scholar_search.sh`, fusing OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and ERIC (incl. EdWorkingPapers), merging paper versions, and saving raw responses, a fenced digest and a MANIFEST row for every call. Subcommands: citation verification (verify: catches fabricated references), forward/backward snowballing, more-like-this, passages inside OA papers, cached full text, legal OA copies and licenses (oa), retraction checks (Crossref/Retraction Watch, Scite notices), Scite citation-stance tallies (supporting/contradicting), and Elicit study-type-tagged search and paid async research reports (spend-gated). Use for literature reviews, finding papers or evidence on a question, checking that a citation exists, was retracted, or is supported or contradicted by later work, or locating an OA PDF. Strong for education and social science. Grey literature goes through the web-retrieval skill. NOT for dataset discovery (education-data-explorer).
